messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU capacity exhaustion detected in prod-us-east-1. Alert: autoscaler not responding, queue length > 12k. Paging @maria (SRE on-call).

maria: on it, seeing alerts spike. grabbing logs now.

maria: initial triage — pods in inference-gpu pool are at 100% alloc, some are OOM-killed, HPA target replicas stuck at 8 while desired would be ~30. queue_worker_count metric shows 12500.

ajay: @maria are we seeing HPAFailures or metrics adapter errors in controller logs?

maria: good call, checking controller-manager logs. found repeated errors from metrics-server -> metrics adapter: "failed to get metrics for resource: timed out contacting prometheus-adapter"

sophia: that matches a Prometheus scrape backlog I saw earlier. prometheus memory spiked and the remote_write started dropping points.

maria: pastes logs:

```
E0315 12:05:44.123 controller.go:256] HorizontalPodAutoscaler failed to get cpu metrics: error getting metrics from adapter: adapter internal error: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
E0315 12:05:44.125 kubelet.go:89] metrics-server: connection refused
```

eng-runtime: tagging in — we're observing long tail latencies and token-level throttling on the API. Queue length correlates with worker pods not scaling.

ajay: looks like the HPA is starved of custom metrics (queue length / pending_requests metric). If metrics-adapter can't query prometheus, HPA will fall back or freeze depending on config.

maria: mitigation plan proposal:
1) temporarily kubectl scale inference-gpu-deployment --replicas=40 to exhaust capacity slower (manual scale)
2) restart prometheus-adapter and metrics-server to restore metrics pipeline
3) route lower-priority customers to CPU-backed fallback model (machine-reroute) to reduce GPU load
4) continue probing cause of prometheus memory spike

sophia: +1. I'll start the adapter restart. pulling a rolling restart on prometheus-adapter now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring`

eng-runtime: I can flip a traffic rule to send non-SLAs to small-quantized models — will do once we have an approved list. @maria want me to start rerouting now?

maria: yes, do it. annotate which customers are affected then support-bot can send triage notes.

support-bot: auto-note: preparing customer-impact list for requests queued > 60s. Will post summary in 10m.

ajay: restarting metrics-server as well: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/metrics-server -n kube-system`. watching HPA now.

(2m later)

sophia: prometheus-adapter pods restarting, one failed due to OOM. Increasing adapter memory from 200Mi -> 512Mi as temp workaround: `kubectl set resources deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --limits=memory=512Mi --requests=memory=256Mi`

maria: manual scale executed: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gpu-deployment --replicas=40 -n prod`. Observing pod creations.

eng-runtime: Started reroute for non-paid customers to fallback-model-v1 on edge routers. This will lower GPU load ~30%.

sophia: prometheus is still reporting backlog. remote_write retries are high, GC pressure on TSDB. I'm going to increase retention? that might be heavy. Instead, I'll reduce scrape frequency for high-cardinality metrics temporarily: patching prometheus scrape config for model_latency_* and per-customer metrics to 60s.

ajay: note — HPA uses custom metric `queue_length` scraped as a single series per deployment. If we changed scrape to 60s, HPA resolution will be coarser but ok for now.

maria: HPA controller still showing adapter timeout errors but some metrics start to flow. queue_length sample dropped from 12.5k to 7.8k after reroutes and scale.

support-bot: customer-impact summary (prelim): ~420 active requests experiencing >2x latency, 14 customers with errors >5% including two enterprise customers (enterprise-acme, enterprise-beta). Preparing outreach drafts.

customer-success: drafting notification for enterprise-acme. want to include ETA for full recovery. what are we estimating?

maria: ETA: 30-60min to stabilize given pod spin-up and metrics pipeline catch-up. will update if prolonged.

(6m later)

eng-runtime: we see token-throttling reduced. New GPU pods are Ready. Autoscaler still not increasing automatically because of intermittent adapter timeouts.

ajay: I'm going to exec into adapter pod and run a manual query against prometheus to verify responses.

ajay: (exec) `curl -s http://prometheus-operated.monitoring.svc:9090/api/v1/query?query=queue_length` -> returning data but with older timestamps, prom returned 30s delay on series.

sophia: confirmed. TSDB compaction paused for ~5m due to OOM earlier, causing staleness.

maria: I'm going to temporarily patch the HPA to switch to CPU-based metric fallback so it can autoscale while adapter recovers: applying `kubectl patch hpa inference-gpu-hpa -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":60}}}]}}'`

eng-runtime: after patch, HPA is scaling based on CPU and increased to 28 replicas automatically.

support-bot: outreach draft ready for enterprise-acme: "We're investigating degraded inference performance in US-East. Immediate mitigations applied; routing and manual scale implemented. Estimated 30-60min." Approve to send? @customer-success

customer-success: send. cc: @maria @eng-runtime. Also opening a priority ticket for account manager.

(10m later)

sophia: prometheus-adapter stable now. memory pressure remedied by reducing scrape density and adapter mem bump. metrics streaming to adapter consistently, timestamps current.

ajay: controller logs show HPA metrics fetch success. removing CPU-fallback patch and restoring custom metric config.

maria: rolling HPA config back to queue_length metric:
`kubectl apply -f hpa-queue-metric.yaml`

eng-runtime: HPA now following queue metric and target replicas adjusting down to 24 as queue length drops.

maria: current numbers: queue_length 1.2k, GPUs utilized ~70%, average latency normalized to within SLA for paid customers, non-paid still on fallback.

support-bot: final impact: ~10 customers experienced transient errors >5% for ~18 minutes, two enterprise customers saw elevated latency for ~35 minutes. No data loss.

customer-success: messaging sent to impacted customers; internal postmortem ticket created: PM-INC-2060001234.

maria: handing over to second on-call for post-incident analysis — @eli taking the remainder. Leaving notes:
- Root cause: Prometheus OOM + adapter memory exhaustion -> adapter timeouts -> HPA lacked custom metrics -> no autoscaling
- Mitigations used: manual scale, traffic reroute to CPU fallback, increase adapter memory, reduce scrape frequency, restart metrics components, patch HPA to CPU fallback
- Follow-ups: hard-limit TSDB retention, add alert for prometheus memory and remote_write error rate, add circuit-breaker for adapter failures that triggers fallback autoscale, run load test for adapter resiliency

eli: taking over, acknowledged. Will coordinate postmortem and CLs. tagging oncall runbook updates: add explicit manual-scale play and customer-notify template.

maria: thanks team. closing page. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: incident moved to 'mitigated' at 12:43 UTC, assigned to owner eli for postmortem.
